```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "hide"}
x_sol <- sample(2:12, 1)
a <- sample(2:9, 1)
b <- sample(1:15, 1)
c <- a * x_sol + b
```

Question
========
Resolva a equação $`r a`x + `r b` = `r c`$ e informe o valor de $x$.

Solution
========
Isolando $x$: $x = (`r c` - `r b`) / `r a` = `r x_sol`$.
